description: Delete one joint by joint_id (the Joints card Delete button) and record one assembly undo step. Remaining joints are solved again. A part move that this joint does not name stays. Undo restores the joint. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

joint_id.description: Joint id from a joint_create or joint_commit result

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: joint_delete
